statements.text: The rise of innovation in the world of artificial intelligence is exciting; however, it has potential to do some major harm if left in the wrong hands. The Protecting Consumers from Deceptive AI Act protects Americans from being duped by deepfakes and other means of deception by setting standards for identifying AI generated content. Establishing this simple safeguard is vital to protecting our children, consumers, and our national security.

statements.text: As AI technology advances at a rapid pace, our laws must keep up. When criminals use AI to steal identities or defraud Americans, the consequences should be severe to match the crime. The AI Fraud Deterrence Act strengthens penalties for crimes related to fraud committed with the help of AI. I am proud to co-lead this legislation to protect the identities of the public and prevent misuse of this innovative technology.
statements.venue: Press release on the AI Fraud Deterrence Act (with Rep. Lieu)
